description.value: Jugo Juice is a Canadian smoothie and fresh-pressed juice franchise founded in 1998 in Calgary, offering made-to-order smoothies, fresh-pressed juices, bubble teas, smoothie bowls, wraps, and grilled sandwiches. The Davie Street location in Vancouver provides both indoor and outdoor seating alongside takeout service. The menu is built around health-forward ingredients with strong vegan, vegetarian, and dairy-free options — a useful refuelling stop for cyclists looking for lighter fare.
